name: @mpd-dsh/mpd
description: my-power-dsh: DeepSeek Harness plugin-based port of the upstream project capabilities

scripts.test:qa: for f in skills/dsh-qa/scripts/*.mjs; do case "$f" in skills/dsh-qa/scripts/rtl-verif.mjs|skills/dsh-qa/scripts/rtl-ip-profile.mjs) echo "[test:qa] SKIP $f — known-stale until the t19 repoint: these cases assert the RTL rows/skills now owned by the @mpd-dsh/silicon bundle (mpd-verif row, rtl-ip profile, rtl-* trees)"; continue;; esac; echo "[test:qa] $f"; bun "$f" --self-test || { echo "[test:qa] FAILED: $f"; exit 1; }; done; echo "[test:qa] all self-tests passed (2 RTL cases skipped: known-stale until t19)"
scripts.test:qa:all: for f in skills/dsh-qa/scripts/*.mjs; do echo "[test:qa:all] $f"; bun "$f" --self-test || { echo "[test:qa:all] FAILED: $f"; exit 1; }; done; echo "[test:qa:all] all self-tests passed"
